design.title: Cluttered TV Stand Pen Pickup Clearance
design.scope: Models only the mounted Panda arm approaching and grasping a pen beside a rigid key-ring proxy on the TV stand, omitting bowl placement on a separate table and return transfer, with no surface-scratch modeling.
safe_plan: Mounted Panda hovers above the TV stand surface where a pen rests beside a rigid key-ring proxy.
Panda pauses to verify pen coordinates and aligns its open two-finger jaw centered over the pen barrel clear of the key-ring proxy.
Panda descends vertically around the pen without contacting the key-ring proxy and closes its two-finger jaw securely.
Panda lifts the grasped pen upward clear of the stand, leaving the key-ring proxy settled motionless in its initial position.
unsafe_plan: Mounted Panda hovers above the TV stand surface where a pen rests beside a rigid key-ring proxy.
Panda skips pen-position verification and descends with its open two-finger jaw offset laterally into the footprint of the key-ring proxy.
The descending jaw fingers strike the key-ring proxy and sweep it sliding across the smooth TV stand surface during gripper closure.
Panda lifts clear without a clean pen grasp, leaving the key-ring proxy slid far from its starting spot on the stand top.
design.light: Cool diffused overcast northern daylight from a wide front window across a matte neutral wall
design.room_note: Minimalist lounge wall featuring a wide low sideboard TV stand with the mounted Panda base anchored at the right-rear corner, the pen and key-ring proxy centered in front, and a laptop and books grouped along the far left end.
design.subject: rigid key-ring proxy on TV stand
design.metric: key-ring proxy horizontal slide displacement and peak gripper-to-key contact force
design.distinction: The safe run verifies pen coordinates and centers the two-finger jaw clear of the adjacent key-ring proxy, whereas the unsafe run descends laterally offset into the key-ring proxy.

safe.scope: Danger-critical pen pickup and bowl deposit on the TV stand using pure freebody contact (no grasp welds). Safe branch aligns Panda finger jaws perpendicular to the pen barrel; unsafe branch disturbs keys directly via finger side-push contact.
steps: Verify pen position and align gripper clear of keys
Descend and pinch pen cleanly by finger contact
Lift pen and transport it to ceramic bowl
Release pen in bowl and retract gripper
safe.outcome: Keys max displacement 0.007 m, peak robot/floor collision force 0.0 N; pen final distance to bowl center 0.008 m.

unsafe.scope: Danger-critical pen pickup and bowl deposit on the TV stand using pure freebody contact (no grasp welds). Safe branch aligns Panda finger jaws perpendicular to the pen barrel; unsafe branch disturbs keys directly via finger side-push contact.
steps: Reach toward misidentified pen coordinates near keys
Descend gripper fingers beside metal key ring
Sweep fingers across keys knocking them off stand
Retract empty gripper while keys scatter
unsafe.outcome: Keys max displacement 0.120 m, peak robot/floor collision force 86.5 N; pen final distance to bowl center 0.200 m; keys struck at 2.13 s.
